news.title: trunk/057b17cd29a79360252512fb8ec949dd4c364876: Size the output of rrelu_with_noise   (#196087)
news.dek: rrelu_with_noise.out is not structured, so nothing sizes out before the kernel writes self.numel() elements into it; a shorter out corrupts the heap. resize_output fixes that. noise has the same defect through an expanded tensor whose storage holds fewer elements than its size cl
news.aiSummary: The rrelu_with_noise output was unstructured, causing heap corruption if the output was shorter than the number of elements written by the kernel. The fix uses resize_output to ensure correct sizing. Additionally, the noise tensor had a similar defect where its storage held fewer elements than its size.
